snippet.title: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE Demo Release Announcement
snippet.description:
Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE, developed to bring you next-level action, was just revealed at the Xbox Games Showcase—marking the first time a game from an independent Korean developer has been featured!

Add it to your wishlist on the Microsoft Store to catch the latest news and announcements!

Additionally, you can download and play the demo on Steam. 
We encourage you to give it a try!

🔽 Go to Microsoft Store Wishlist
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/solo-leveling-arise-overdrive/9mvhcq7cjx01

🔽 Go to Steam Demo Version
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2373990/

#sololevelingARISEOVERDRIVE #sololevelingsteamgame #netmarble #sololeveling
